app TypedKeyedSchedule
use std {EmailV1 as Mail} from=deployment.mail
Given
 Entry { label:text, eligible:bool=true, fired:int=0, observedVersion:int=0 }
 event Due { entry:Entry }
 policy Entry read=public
When
 crud Entry by=owner fields=label,eligible
 ## Scheduling this record key again replaces its pending occurrence.
 ## A refusal after staging must preserve the previous row and schedule.
 scenario arm(entry:Entry,at:datetime,accept:bool) -> int by=owner
  do
   set entry {eligible=true}
   schedule entry.id at=at event=Due {entry}
   require accept
   return entry.version
 ## Cancellation and eligibility changes share the admitted transaction.
 scenario stop(entry:Entry,accept:bool) -> int by=owner
  do
   set entry {eligible=false}
   cancel entry.id
   require accept
   return entry.version
 ## At due execution, the declared reference resolves the current row.
 ## Eligibility and observedVersion must come from that row, not enqueue time.
 scenario fire on=Due
  do
   require actor==null
   require operation.source=="schedule"
   ## Progress stays provisional until current eligibility succeeds.
   set event.entry {fired=event.entry.fired+1,observedVersion=event.entry.version}
   send Mail.send {to="schedule@example.test",subject=operation.id,body=team.id} as notice
   require event.entry.eligible
Then
